name: FRIDAY
description: Soul layer: owner-only admission, PII/secret egress safety, prompt-injection labelling, lockdown kill switch, and chat command intake.

ownerIds.description: Owner sender identities (channel user ids). Only these may reach tools and memory. Empty means no one is admitted (fail-closed).

lockedDown.description: When true, non-essential model egress is blocked (the /lockdown kill switch).

personaDir.description: Owner-controlled directory holding PERSONA.md and CONSTITUTION.md. Defaults to the process working directory.

ownerIds.label: Owner IDs
ownerIds.help: Only these exact sender ids are admitted. Leave empty to admit no one.

personaDir.label: Persona directory
personaDir.help: Holds PERSONA.md and CONSTITUTION.md. Keep it outside agent-writable workspaces.
